result.rationale: The diff newly wraps the admin group fields in <form class="form-horizontal"> (group.hbs) while the buttons (Add, Save, Delete) have no type="button" and only Ember {{action}} handlers, which do not prevent native submit. Pressing Enter in the name text-field or user-selector input inside a form without a submit interceptor triggers native form submission (GET to current URL), causing a full page reload that discards unsaved edits. The form wrapper is introduced by this diff, so the mechanism is directly grounded.

judged_text: The new <form class="form-horizontal"> wraps the group-name text field and the user-selector input while every button inside it lacks type="button", so pressing Enter in either input performs native form submission. The admin types a group name (or a username in the selector) and presses Enter; the browser submits the form as a GET to the current URL and performs a full page reload, discarding every unsaved edit — name, visibility, alias level — with no save and no error.

adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces a literal `<form class="form-horizontal">` wrapper in `admin/templates/group.hbs` around `{{text-field ...}}`, the user-selector input, and several `<button {{action ...}}>` elements. None of these buttons specify `type="button"`, so they default to `type="submit"` in HTML. There is also no `{{action ... on="submit"}}` or other submit handler on the `<form>` to prevent native submission. That makes it verifiable that pressing Enter in an input can trigger native form submission and a full page navigation/reload, potentially discarding unsaved edits.
